title: Rent Discount Program Share of Parking License Early Cancellation Fees
content:
Program terms for households enrolled in a rent discount program on their Apartment Home Lease: the program sets the share of a Parking License early cancellation fee that the household bears.

## Terms

When the lease is enrolled in the active military rent discount program, the program share is 0; when the lease is enrolled in the preferred employer rent discount program, the program share is 0.8; in every other case the program share is one.

The fee months times the fee base is multiplied by the program share.

## Share by program

| Rent discount program on the Apartment Home Lease | Program share |
|---|---|
| active military | 0 |
| preferred employer | 0.8 (80%) |
| none | 1 |

## Illustration (hypothetical fee months times fee base of $65.00)

- Active military program: $65.00 multiplied by 0 is $0.00.
- Preferred employer program: $65.00 multiplied by 0.8 is $52.00.
- No program: $65.00 multiplied by 1 is $65.00.
